title: Margin Man: Lost in the Notebook ✏️ 20 Minutes of Stickman Chaos
description_top:
A stickman lives in the margin of a notebook and draws his way out of every problem… and every drawing makes it worse 😅

Rockets, magnets, portals, a dog that eats pencils, and a monster who just wants cake. 57 short stories, one notebook, zero dialogue, so it's funny in any language.

Which page was your favorite? Tell us in the comments! 👇
